scope: Exact pair-table collectors on frozen extension-field points. The chi arm indexes exact projected sums by the order-three Mobius orbit and verifies the full point; it is not the pending chi polynomial-system oracle. The raw arm is an exact-pair control, not the pending Semaev resultant arm.
one_unit: Whole-solve thread CPU nanoseconds divided by measured thread CPU nanoseconds per source group addition, then divided by sqrt(r); host-dependent L0 only.
other_costs: Exact group-op, base sqrt, lookup, row-op, Fp multiplication/inversion, pair-entry and wall-time counters are retained by phase or row. The calibrated-count S is secondary; whole-solve CPU S includes all native work in this implementation.
success: Every successful arm recovers the same frozen scalar, checked in a separate native process; compare complete cold totals to same-target two-class and six-class rho with A/A timing noise.
stop: Verified scalar, finite cap, or explicit error. Preserve every row and failure. The original polynomial-oracle and four-size isolated-host gates remain open.
